cases.script:
# D3-SO-001: Primary haloalkane: substitution and elimination give different product classes
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
new
add v1 water 40mL @ 25C
add v1 NaOH 0.0003mol
add v2 water 40mL @ 90C
add v2 NaOH 0.0003mol
seal v1 500mL
seal v2 500mL
add v1 bromoethane 0.0002mol
add v2 bromoethane 0.0002mol
react v1 haloalkane
react v2 haloalkane
measure v1 thermometer
measure v2 thermometer
particles v1
particles v2
chromatograph v1
chromatograph v2
inspect
cases.original_physical_forecast: The installed table selects substitution in the cooler branch and elimination in the hotter branch: ethanol versus ethene, both with bromide-containing products. Establish product identity from inventory, not simply a pressure difference between hot and cool vessels.

acceptance.ledger: For each React compare immediately preceding complete vessel contents with post-state plus all externally transferred material events; include all gas and trapped headspace baseline, ionic portions with their charges, free proton/hydroxide only where separately owned. Count solution diagnostics only as diagnostic, never double-count solution and authoritative contents. Preserve unknown species as unevaluated ledger, not zero.
acceptance.coproduct_policy: NaBr/HBr can be represented as canonical dissociated ionic equivalents; do not demand molecular salt where solver owns ions. Reconcile Na,Br,H and charge rather than adding counterions.
acceptance.refusal: Preserve named absence/admission/refusal. Mechanism absent or source-owned base missed is unsupported/model investigation, never silently rewrite identity or physical forecast.
